name: Cables Unlimited - Custom Cable Manufacturing
old_description: Cables Unlimited is a manufacturer of custom cable assemblies, custom wire harnesses, fiber cables, and custom hybrid cables to meet even the most unique challenges of the communications, automotive, military, robotic, industrial, wireless, and medical industries.
about:
Cables Unlimited operates from Yaphank, New York, where it has been producing custom cable assemblies for over 30 years. The company became a division of RF Industries (Nasdaq: RFIL) following an acquisition in June 2011, expanding its reach into the telecommunications sector. No individual founders are named in public materials.

The company designs and manufactures custom cable assemblies, wire harnesses, fiber optic cables, and hybrid cables. Its in-house capabilities span engineering design assistance, rapid prototyping, and low‑ to high‑volume production. The facility handles everything from simple copper assemblies to complex hybrid cables for cell‑tower and distributed‑antenna systems.

Cables Unlimited serves wireless and telecom carriers upgrading to 5G and LTE, military and aerospace programs requiring mil‑spec and tactical cables, robotics firms needing high‑flex‑life solutions, data‑center and networking customers using Cat 5/6 and fiber, medical device manufacturers, industrial OEMs, and enterprise clients. The company also provides installation services through certified technicians.

The business emphasizes fast turnaround and low minimum orders, backed by a Corning Gold Cable Assembly House designation that enables a 25‑year extended warranty on select fiber products. Quality certifications include AS9100D/ISO 9001:2015, UL recognition, RoHS compliance, and IPC/WHMA‑A‑620. ITAR registration allows work on defense‑related projects, and the team notes a willingness to work around the clock to meet urgent deadlines.
